display_title: HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-03-07 Europe’s world class research and technology infrastructures as strategic assets for talent to Choose Europe – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-03-07 Europe’s world class research and technology infrastructures as strategic assets for talent to Choose Europe
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Coordination and Support Action (horizontal Bridging actions call) that funds networks, training programmes, scientific visits and outreach to use Europe's research and technology infrastructures to attract global scientific talent and strengthen international scientific cooperation, in one of nine areas, one of which is 'Clean energy and clean mobility solutions'. Consortia must include at least one ESFRI Landmark and/or ERIC as beneficiary; the lump-sum grant covers 100% of costs. The topic budget is EUR 7.5 million for about 5 projects of around EUR 1.5 million each. Opens 9 March 2027; single-stage deadline 15 June 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027 Part 14 (Horizontal Activities), pp. 83–86 (HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-03-07, Expected Outcome and Scope), funds networking, training, visits and outreach that promote Europe's research and technology infrastructures to international scientific talent, in one of nine scientific areas. It does not touch TenneT's field: the work is science diplomacy and talent attraction for research infrastructures, and the 'Clean energy and clean mobility solutions' area only labels the scientific field of the infrastructures involved, without any work on energy systems, grids or TenneT's workforce; no project file is close. No project start, end or duration is stated, so both project dates are null.
